_comment: US Federal Reserve / OCC / FDIC regional control-mapping profile. SR 26-2 is the active primary framework for traditional model risk. Agentic controls governed under ISO 42001 per SR 26-2 Footnote 3 (novelty exclusion). To activate: set CAGE_DEPLOYMENT_REGION=US_FED
_references: SR 26-2 (Model Risk Management for Agentic AI Systems)
SR 11-7 (Guidance on Model Risk Management, legacy baseline)

CTRL_AGT_001.description: Minimum agentic model confidence required to execute a trade. Agentic AI is explicitly excluded from SR 26-2 MRM scope (Footnote 3); governed here under ISO 42001 Operational Risk.

CTRL_WAL_002.description: Atomic transaction guarantee via Write-Ahead Log and LIFO rollback. MCP tool invocations in forward WAL nodes must be provably atomic in production, not merely declared in policy documents.

co_frameworks: DORA Art. 10 – ICT-Related Incident Detection and Monitoring
CTRL_TEL_003.description: World-model validation must reflect live runtime telemetry, not synthetic data. DoWhy causal gatekeeper placebo refutation must be sourced from live Langfuse governance spans.

co_frameworks: SR 11-7 (legacy baseline, superseded by SR 26-2 for agentic components)
CTRL_MRM_004.description: Traditional quantitative model validation criteria applicable to non-agentic, deterministic ML components (e.g. CBF predictor, DoWhy causal model coefficients). SR 26-2 explicitly retains MRM scope for these components.

CTRL_OPA_005.description: OPA policy evaluation must ALLOW before any agentic action is executed. DENY or MANUAL_REVIEW outcomes constitute a policy violation and must surface as GovernanceError.
